name: List Engineering jobs on World Labs careers page
intent: Find and list all Engineering job openings at World Labs
summary: Navigates to the World Labs careers page, jumps to the open-roles section via the 'Explore open roles' button, expands the Engineering accordion, and records every Engineering role title and location. Reusable as a template for checking current Engineering openings; the actual role list must be read from the live page since postings change.
route_strategy: Replay deterministically to the Engineering section of worldlabs.ai/careers, then read the live role list instead of trusting cached role names.

do: Click the black 'Explore open roles' button below the 'Join our team' text to jump to the roles section (URL should become #open-roles)
Click the Engineering accordion row labeled with a roles count (e.g. '3 roles') and a chevron to expand it
Read each Engineering role's title and location from the expanded list and save them in the final note
Preserve goal-specific target hints: find, out, engineering, job, oppurtunities, world, labs, list.
Prefer the observed successful final URL when it still matches the goal: https://www.worldlabs.ai/careers#open-roles.
Patch: Always supply a 'description' parameter with color/text/position cues, e.g. 'Engineering row with 3 roles label and chevron on the right'.
Patch: Click 'Explore open roles' as soon as the careers page has loaded.
Patch: Read and save the role list immediately once expansion is visually confirmed.
avoid: Do not issue VisualClick without the required 'description' parameter (steps 5-6 were rejected twice for this)
Do not insert TimedWait steps before or after clicks — they had no observable effect in the source run
Do not hardcode the recorded role names as the answer without re-reading the page; postings may have changed
Do not replay source step 2: Idle wait with no observable effect before the 'Explore open roles' click.
Do not replay source step 3: Duplicate idle wait, no observable effect.
Do not replay source step 5: Failed VisualClick — missing required 'description' parameter, no page change.
Do not replay source step 6: Retry of the same malformed VisualClick, still no page change.
Do not replay source step 8: Idle wait after accordion expansion, no observable effect.
Do not replay source step 9: Idle wait after accordion expansion, no observable effect.
Avoid failure: VisualClick rejected twice ('Missing required parameter description') when trying to expand the Engineering accordion.
Avoid failure: Two 1s waits before clicking 'Explore open roles' added latency with no benefit.
Avoid failure: Two 1s waits after the Engineering accordion expanded delayed extraction without aiding verification.
checkpoints: URL is worldlabs.ai/careers#open-roles and the open-roles list is in view
Engineering accordion expanded with role titles and locations visible
Target page title should resemble: [Tab 1/1] Careers | World Labs.
Pause after dynamic search/result-selection states unless the next action is replay-safe.
stop_conditions: Careers page structure changed: no 'Explore open roles' button or no Engineering accordion row exists
Engineering accordion does not expand after clicking
Roles count or contents differ from expectations in a way that needs live-agent judgment
If the current page no longer matches the workflow state, stop replay and hand back to the live planner.
If an answer text must be read from the current screenshot, stop before templated SaveNote and let the live answer finalizer read it.
